description: This Java class 'UserService' manages user and role management within a Spring Boot backend. It includes methods for initializing default users and roles, retrieving a user by username, and authenticating users to get their roles.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service class for managing users and roles, including initialization, retrieval, and authentication.

methods.name: ensureDefaults
methods.description: Initializes default roles and users if they do not already exist.

methods.name: getByUsernameOrThrow
methods.description: Retrieves a User by username, throwing an exception if not found.

methods.name: authenticateAndGetRoles
methods.description: Verifies user credentials and returns their roles if authentication is successful.
